extension.news: V1.4.14 - chore: refactoring - fix: force TLS1.2 to retrieve playback data V1.4.13 - feat: added proxy support V1.4.12 - fix: calendar does not always show the data for today when opened for the first time V1.4.11 - fix: typo V1.4.10 - fix: switched from requests to urllib3 for api calls V1.4.9 - fix: playback data cannot be retrieved - fix: package permission detection V1.4.8 - fix: playback data cannot be retrieved - chore: updated values for playback data, user-agent, x-dazn-ua V1.4.7 - chore: removed modules 'six' and 'kodi-six' - feat: refactoring drm properties for inputstream adaptive - feat: show the portrait image if no title is set - feat: use image api v3 V1.4.6 - added missing arts parameter for 'play from beginning' V1.4.5 - fixed error when 'CdnToken' is not in plackback data - added arts for streams started via context menu - updated values for AppVersion, user-agent, x-dazn-ua V1.4.4 - fixed playback of some streams V1.4.3 - fixed error 404 when retrieving user profile V1.4.2 - fixed resolution problem on android devices V1.4.1 - fixed playback for Kodi Nexus V1.4.0 - fixed playback - added the date of an event in the title V1.3.26 - improved package permission detection - use the ia property to play a buffered live stream from the beginning V1.3.25 - colored display of unplayable streams (package permission) V1.3.24 - fixed wrong function calls - fixed login V1.3.23 - fixed lowercase error for "Start from beginning" feature V1.3.22 - generation of a UUID for Android version 11 and higher, since "Network.MacAddress" returns an empty string - reset device id on logout - fix ListItem properties deprecations - show additional error message - dynamically determine the maximum number of devices that can be registered - fixed "Start from beginning" for live events V1.3.21 - fixed missing PIN prompt when starting a stream via "Start from Beginning" context menu - fixed error when adding stream infos on kodi 18 and 19
